After card 229, Grok seats receive the whole prompt (--prompt-file), but in 8 of 10 window attempts a Grok seat replied with narration only ("I'll read ...") and stopped with no vote. In the other 2 (w229scr2cp1-coach, w229sc2cp1-coach) it voted NO OBJECTION with a valid CITE after the narration, and the facilitator's window runner, which reads the vote from the first line, dropped it. Under decider.py a no-vote is "none", which fails the result, so Grok cannot yet sit in a counted decision seat.
